label: Deltron · novi Webfront
htmlContent: <!doctype html><html lang="{{wf:lang}}"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">{{wf:head}}{{wf:styles}}</head><body data-release="{{wf:release}}"><header class="dt-site-header">{{region:header}}</header><main class="dt-main" id="main-content">{{region:main}}</main><footer class="dt-footer">Deltron d.o.o.</footer>{{wf:scripts}}</body></html>

styles.name: deltron-site.css
styles.content: :root{color-scheme:light;--dt-blue:#0069ad;--dt-ink:#193249;--dt-muted:#5e6f7d;--dt-line:#d6e0e7;--dt-bg:#f5f7f9;--dt-error:#b42318;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:var(--dt-ink);background:var(--dt-bg)}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0}a{color:var(--dt-blue)}button,input,select{font:inherit}button,a,input,select{touch-action:manipulation}button{cursor:pointer}[hidden]{display:none!important}:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #399ad2;outline-offset:3px}.dt-site-header{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--dt-line)}.dt-header{width:min(1120px,calc(100% - 48px));min-height:84px;display:flex;gap:40px;align-items:center;margin:auto}.dt-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin-right:auto}.dt-brand img{object-fit:contain;width:150px;height:44px}.dt-header nav a{text-decoration:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--dt-ink);padding:12px 0}.dt-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid var(--dt-blue);border-radius:5px;padding:11px 22px;background:var(--dt-blue);color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;min-height:42px}.dt-button:hover{background:#00568e}.dt-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait}.dt-account{position:relative}.dt-account summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;min-height:44px}.dt-account summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.dt-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:#e7f1f8;color:#005c97;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.dt-account-panel{position:absolute;z-index:10;right:0;top:calc(100% + 12px);width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dt-line);border-radius:6px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #19324912}.dt-account-panel>a,.dt-account-panel>button{display:block;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--dt-ink);text-decoration:none;text-align:left;padding:12px;font-size:14px;border-radius:4px}.dt-account-panel>a:hover,.dt-account-panel>button:hover{background:var(--dt-bg)}.dt-account-panel>p{margin:0 12px 8px;color:var(--dt-muted);font-size:12px}.dt-main{min-height:calc(100vh - 150px)}.dt-warranty{width:min(980px,calc(100% - 48px));margin:42px auto 64px}.dt-page-heading{margin-bottom:28px}.dt-eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.11em;color:var(--dt-blue);margin:0 0 12px}h1{font-size:28px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:700}.dt-muted{color:var(--dt-muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;margin:0}.dt-form{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dt-line);border-radius:7px;padding:30px}.dt-form fieldset{border:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 30px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px 24px;min-width:0}.dt-form legend{width:100%;padding:0 0 14px;margin:0 0 22px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4eaf0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--dt-ink)}.dt-field{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.dt-field label{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600}.dt-required{color:var(--dt-blue);margin-left:3px}.dt-control{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:43px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #bac9d5;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;color:var(--dt-ink);font-size:14px}.dt-control:focus{outline:2px solid #0069ad33;border-color:var(--dt-blue)}.dt-control[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--dt-error)}.dt-control[type=file]{font-size:12px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer}.dt-control::file-selector-button{border:0;border-radius:3px;background:#eaf0f5;color:var(--dt-ink);padding:7px 10px;margin-right:10px}.dt-help,.dt-field-error{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;margin:0}.dt-help{color:var(--dt-muted)}.dt-field-error{color:var(--dt-error)}.dt-field-wide{grid-column:1/-1}.dt-check{flex-direction:row;align-items:start}.dt-check input{width:18px;height:18px;margin:2px 0;accent-color:var(--dt-blue);flex-shrink:0}.dt-check>div{display:grid;gap:6px}.dt-actions{border-top:1px solid #e4eaf0;padding-top:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between}.dt-actions>p{font-size:12px;color:var(--dt-muted)}.dt-status{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;white-space:pre-wrap}.dt-error{color:var(--dt-error)}.dt-notice{border-left:3px solid var(--dt-blue);padding:12px 16px;background:#edf5fa;color:#24536f;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 24px}.dt-success{padding:30px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #bddccc;border-radius:7px}.dt-success h2{font-size:22px;color:#207344}.dt-login{width:min(440px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:60px auto 80px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dt-line);border-radius:7px;padding:32px}.dt-login [data-dt-login]{margin-top:24px;--front-auth-width:100%;--front-auth-button-bg:var(--dt-blue);--front-auth-button-text:#fff;--front-auth-radius:4px}.dt-back{display:inline-block;margin-top:24px;font-size:13px;text-decoration:none}.dt-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--dt-line);padding:22px 24px;color:var(--dt-muted);font-size:12px;text-align:center}.dt-field .iti{width:100%}.dt-field .iti input{padding-left:90px}.dt-login .efa-root{padding:0}.dt-login [data-efa-view=account]{overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(max-width:650px){.dt-header{width:calc(100% - 32px);min-height:74px;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:14px 0}.dt-brand img{width:124px;height:36px}.dt-header nav{order:3;width:100%;border-top:1px solid #e4eaf0;padding-top:12px}.dt-header nav a{font-size:13px}.dt-button{padding:10px 16px}.dt-warranty{width:calc(100% - 28px);margin:28px auto 40px}h1{font-size:24px}.dt-form{padding:22px 18px}.dt-form fieldset{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.dt-actions{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}.dt-actions .dt-button{width:100%}.dt-login{margin:30px auto;padding:25px}.dt-account summary>[data-dt-name]{max-width:115px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}}
